_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Citadel: Forged with Fire egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Citadel: Forged with Fire
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The sandbox fantasy RPG of magic, flying broomsticks and castle building. Installs the Linux dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; sed -i -E -e "s/ServerName=\"[^\"]*\"/ServerName=\"{{SERVER_NAME}}\"/" -e "s/([(,])Password=\"[^\"]*\"/\\1Password=\"{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}\"/" -e "s/ServerType=[A-Za-z]+/ServerType={{SERVER_TYPE}}/" -e "s/PlayerLimit=[0-9]+/PlayerLimit={{MAX_PLAYERS}}/" Citadel/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/Game.ini; exec ./Citadel/Binaries/Linux/CitadelServer-Linux-Shipping Citadel -log -Port={{SERVER_PORT}}

config.startup: {"done": "Steam Server initialized and registered with UWorks"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Citadel: Forged with Fire. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app
# 489650) with SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Saves and the settings in
# Game.ini are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-489650}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The server's Steam library looks for steamclient.so next to its plugin.
ln -sfn ../../../../../../linux64/steamclient.so Citadel/Plugins/UWorks/Source/ThirdParty/Linux/steamclient.so
# Game.ini holds the ports, the admin password and the world settings. The
# Panel sets the ports and admin password; the startup sets the name, password,
# type and player limit in WorldCreationSettings. Everything else is yours.
cfg=Citadel/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/Game.ini
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$cfg")"
if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then
    cat > "$cfg" <<'EOF'
[UWorks]
ConnectionPort=7777
QueryPort=27015

[/Script/Citadel.SocialManager]
Password=

[/Script/Citadel.CitadelGameInstance]
WorldCreationSettings=(ServerName="A Citadel server",Password="",ServerType=PVP,PlayerLimit=20,bPrivate=false,ExperienceMultiplier=1.000000,InventoryCapacityMultipler=1.000000,KnowledgePointEarnedMultiplier=1.000000,CharacterPointEarnedMultiplier=1.000000,bUnlimitedResources=false,PlayerDamageMultiplier=1.000000,ArmorMultiplier=1.000000,BaseManaRegen=1.000000,bInventoryWeightRestrictions=true,MagicFindMultiplier=1.000000,CraftingMagicFindChanceMultiplier=1.000000,FlyingCostMultiplier=1.000000,FlyingSpeedMultiplier=1.000000,ResourceCollectionMultiplier=1.000000,StructureDamageMultiplier=1.000000,bRespectNoBuildZones=true,MagicStructureManaRegenerationMultiplier=1.000000,MagicStructureManaConsumptionMultiplier=0.000000,bFreeBuildMode=false,TimeOfDayLock=Auto,NPCPopulationMultiplier=1.000000,StructureDecayMultiplier=2.000000,bThronesDecay=true)
EOF
    echo "Made Game.ini."
fi
echo "Installed Citadel: Forged with Fire build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Server type
variables.description: PVP lets players fight each other; PVE doesn't.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password players enter in game to become admins. Empty turns it off.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
